Enterprise & commercialisation

Personalise

UNSW supports its experts and innovators with exposure to opportunities and partnerships to swiftly and effectively translate scientific research into commercialable reality. We also support entrepreneurs of all levels with the systems and training required to hone their skills and increase the probability of having a successful startup endeavour.
